---
title: "EconML tutorial series"
description: "A hands-on tutorial series for heterogeneous treatment effects, orthogonal learners, causal forests, meta-learners, policy learning, and CATE reporting with EconML."
categories: [EconML, Causal ML, Heterogeneous Effects]
---

EconML is the tutorial track for CATE estimation and treatment targeting once the causal question and adjustment strategy are clear.

<figure class="course-page-figure">
<img src="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/outputs/figures/04_cate_recovery_scatter.png" alt="Scatter plot comparing estimated and true heterogeneous treatment effects in an EconML tutorial">
<figcaption>Figure: CATE recovery diagnostics from the EconML causal forest workflow, showing how heterogeneous-effect estimates are evaluated (adapted from Tutorial 04: CausalForestDML).</figcaption>
</figure>

## Tutorial Sequence

<div class="notebook-guide">
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/00_environment_and_econml_tour.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/00_environment_and_econml_tour.html">00: Environment And Library Tour</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Introduces the EconML ecosystem, the CATE-focused workflow, and the core objects used to connect causal estimands with machine-learning estimators.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/01_cate_foundations_potential_outcomes.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/01_cate_foundations_potential_outcomes.html">01: CATE Foundations And Potential Outcomes</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Builds the potential-outcomes foundation for heterogeneous treatment effects, showing why CATE estimation is a causal problem before it is a modeling problem.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/02_double_machine_learning_basics.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/02_double_machine_learning_basics.html">02: Double Machine Learning Basics</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Explains residualization, nuisance models, cross-fitting, and orthogonalization as the statistical machinery behind many EconML estimators.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/03_lineardml_and_sparselineardml.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/03_lineardml_and_sparselineardml.html">03: LinearDML And SparseLinearDML</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Uses linear and sparse DML estimators to recover interpretable treatment-effect structure while keeping nuisance modeling flexible.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/04_causalforestdml.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/04_causalforestdml.html">04: CausalForestDML</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Develops causal forests as a nonparametric CATE tool, emphasizing effect recovery, segment diagnostics, overlap, and uncertainty in heterogeneous treatment targeting.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/05_drlearner_and_doubly_robust_estimation.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/05_drlearner_and_doubly_robust_estimation.html">05: DRLearner And Doubly Robust Estimation</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Shows how DRLearner combines outcome and propensity models so effect estimation can remain stable when one nuisance component is imperfect.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/06_metalearners_s_t_x_learners.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/06_metalearners_s_t_x_learners.html">06: Meta-Learners: S, T, And X Learners</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Compares S-, T-, and X-learners to show how different modeling decompositions handle treatment imbalance, heterogeneity, and targeting quality.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/07_policy_learning_and_treatment_targeting.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/07_policy_learning_and_treatment_targeting.html">07: Policy Learning And Treatment Targeting</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Turns CATE estimates into treatment rules, budget curves, policy trees, and decision comparisons that can be audited before deployment.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/08_interpretability_shap_and_segments.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/08_interpretability_shap_and_segments.html">08: Interpretability, SHAP, And Segments</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Explains heterogeneous-effect models with feature importance, SHAP-style summaries, local examples, and segment-level diagnostics.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/09_inference_intervals_and_uncertainty.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/09_inference_intervals_and_uncertainty.html">09: Inference, Intervals, And Uncertainty</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Adds uncertainty quantification to CATE workflows, including interval width, policy confidence, bootstrap thinking, and support-aware interpretation.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/10_multiple_treatments_and_continuous_treatments.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/10_multiple_treatments_and_continuous_treatments.html">10: Multiple Treatments And Continuous Treatments</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Extends the workflow beyond binary treatments by covering multi-arm treatment comparisons, continuous doses, marginal effects, and policy tradeoffs.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/11_iv_estimators_deepiv_and_dmliv.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/11_iv_estimators_deepiv_and_dmliv.html">11: Instrumental Variables With DMLIV, OrthoIV, And DeepIV Concepts</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Introduces IV-style causal ML, first-stage strength, exclusion concerns, and heterogeneous-effect recovery when treatment assignment is endogenous.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/12_panel_or_longitudinal_extensions.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/12_panel_or_longitudinal_extensions.html">12: Panel And Longitudinal Extensions</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Frames panel and longitudinal settings as dynamic effect problems, with period-specific treatments, cumulative effects, and policy ranking over time.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/13_estimator_comparison_benchmark.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/13_estimator_comparison_benchmark.html">13: Estimator Comparison Benchmark</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Benchmarks estimators on accuracy, calibration, runtime, segment bias, and targeting performance so method choice becomes empirical rather than cosmetic.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/14_end_to_end_case_study.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/14_end_to_end_case_study.html">14: End-To-End Case Study</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Assembles an applied CATE project from design setup through modeling, validation, targeting, and a decision-ready report.</p>
</article>
<article class="notebook-guide-item">
<p class="notebook-guide-title"><a href="../../notebooks/tutorials/econml/15_common_pitfalls_debugging_reporting.html" data-site-path="notebooks/tutorials/econml/15_common_pitfalls_debugging_reporting.html">15: Common Pitfalls, Debugging, And Reporting</a></p>
<p class="notebook-guide-description">Reviews leakage, post-treatment controls, poor nuisance models, weak overlap, unstable targeting, and reporting checks that protect CATE work from overclaiming.</p>
</article>
</div>
